I am renting this land, so I must be careful with my money, but maize needs good feeding if I want a proper harvest to pay the rent and feed my family. I will buy some urea and NPK from the market in town — not as much as I would like, but enough to push the crop. The rains in the North East have been uncertain, so I cannot irrigate; I depend on the sky. I will use improved seed from the agro-dealer because last time the local seed gave me poor cobs, and I will spray against weeds since hiring people to weed 2.59 hectares by hand is too costly.
